mapper.select: SELECT fb.id AS feeBillId, fb.property_id AS propertyId, up.user_id AS userId, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname, ''), NULLIF(p.owner_name, ''), CONCAT('用户', up.user_id)) AS ownerName, fb.bill_period AS billPeriod, fb.amount AS amount, fb.paid_amount AS paidAmount, fb.due_date AS dueDate FROM fee_bill fb INNER JOIN property p ON p.id = fb.property_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN user_property up ON up.property_id = fb.property_id AND up.is_deleted = 0 AND up.id = ( SELECT up2.id FROM user_property up2 WHERE up2.property_id = fb.property_id AND up2.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY up2.is_primary DESC, up2.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) INNER JOIN `user` u ON u.id = up.user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 WHERE fb.is_deleted = 0 AND fb.status <> 2 AND fb.due_date < NOW() ORDER BY fb.due_date ASC, fb.id ASC
